主要内容: Berkery Noyes released its Q1 2012 Mergers & Acquisitions Trend Report for the Information Industry, covering Media and Marketing, Software, and Online and Mobile companies. The report analyzed merger and acquisition activity from January 1, 2011, to March 31, 2012. Transaction volume remained constant compared to the previous quarter. The median EBITDA multiple increased 27 percent over Q4 2011, rising from 9.6x to 12.2x, while the median revenue multiple fell from 2.2x to 1.6x. 14 percent of the 797 deals in Q1 2012 were backed by Private Equity firms. The Riverside Company was the most active Private Equity acquirer, acquiring DentalPlans.com, BrandMuscle, YourMembership.com, EthicsPoint, and TradeOne Marketing. The largest Private Equity transaction was Advent International and GS Capital Partners' acquisition of TransUnion for $3.1 billion. Data management deals included Perceptive Software's acquisition of Brainware and cybertap's acquisition of DejaVu Technologies. Lexmark International acquired three enterprise content management companies through Perceptive Software, including ISYS Search Software and Nolij Corporation. Berkery Noyes emphasized the growing demand for software solutions capable of handling big data and improving analytics tools through M&A activity in the Information Industry.
